αἰκίζω: to treat injuriously, to plague, torment
αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
βαρύνω: to weigh down, oppress by weight, depress
βλάπτω: to disable, hinder (Hom.); to harm, damage
διαθρύπτω: to break in sunder, break in pieces, shiver
διαπτύσσω: to open and spread out, to unfold, disclose
δολόω: to beguile, ensnare, take by craft
εἰκάζω: to make like to, represent by a likeness, portray
εὐνάζω: put to sleep, place in ambush
εὐνάω: put to sleep, place in ambush
θάπτω: to bury, to honour with funeral rites
θραύω: to break in pieces, shatter, shiver
καινοποιέω: to make new, to bring about new things, to make changes, innovate
καταξαίνω: to card; shred; wear down, waste away
κηδεύω: to take charge of, attend to, ally oneself (in marriage)
κηρύσσω: to be a herald, officiate as herald
κινέω: to set in motion, to move
κλίνω: to make to bend, slope; recline
κρίνω: to pick out, choose, judge, determine
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
μεθορμάομαι: to rush in pursuit of, make a dash at
μεταστρέφω: to turn about, turn round, turn
νεμεσάω: to feel just resentment, to be wroth at undeserved
νομίζω: to have as a custom; to believe
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
πελάζω: to approach, come near, draw near
περαιόω: to carry to the opposite side, carry over
πλέκω: to plait, twine, twist, weave, braid
προστήκομαι: to stick fast to, cling to
προφαίνω: to bring forth, bring to light, shew forth, manifest, display
πυρόω: to burn with fire, burn up
σεύω: to put in quick motion: to drive, hunt, chase away
συναρπάζω: to seize and carry clean away
συντήκω: to fuse into one mass, to weld together
συνταράσσω: to throw all together into confusion, to confound, disturb, trouble
συστέλλω: to draw together, draw in: to shorten sail
σφάλλω: to make to fall, throw down, overthrow
ταριχεύω: to preserve the body by artificial means, to embalm
τρέφω: to nourish, rear, maintain; congeal, curdle
φαίνω: to bring to light, make to appear
φοβέω: to put to flight, to terrify; mid. to fear
χαίρω: to rejoice, be glad, be delighted
χρίω: to touch on the surface: to rub
ἀνάγω: to lead up; mid. set sail
ἀναλίσκω: to use up, to spend, lavish
ἀξιόω: to think worthy of; to expect
ἀποκρίνω: to separate, set apart; mid. answer
ἀποστρέφω: to turn back, turn to flight, turn away
ἀποψύχω: to leave off breathing, to faint, swoon
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἐκπλήσσω: (to knock out); to astound, shock, amaze
ἐκτρέφω: to bring up from childhood, rear up
ἐξωθέω: to thrust out, force out, wrench out
ἐπιμιμνήσκομαι: to remember, think of; to mention
ἐρείπω: throw down, tear down; (m-p and intr aor) fall down, fall into ruins
ἐρημόω: to strip bare, to desolate, lay waste
ἐφίστημι: to set on, over; set in charge of
ἰδνόομαι: to bend oneself, double oneself up, shrink up

ὁρμίζω: to bring to a safe anchorage, bring into harbour, to moor, anchor
ὑποστρέφω: to turn round about, turn back
ῥυσιάζω: to seize as a pledge, to drag away
